title: rosa × collina var. cerasifera
intro: Rosa × collina var. cerasifera, commonly known as the Dog Rose or Wild Rose, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × collina var. cerasifera include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
